answer: Before first payout, the holder links a bird-watching society membership, its number and one signed sighting. Two verifiers match both against the log in a week; a sighting claimed twice, or no fellow member's signature, closes both. Joining costs a 1,500,000-rupiah field course, so one watcher joins once while a thousand fakes need a thousand memberships and 1.5 billion. The watcher notes a sparrow in the yarrow as a falcon circles above.
